in_sanskrit.name: हेमानि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows wealth and prosperity through words, or the one who describes or narrates (Vedas, Puranas, etc.)

in_hindi.name: हेमानि
in_hindi.long_meaning: Goddess of wealth, Goddess of the throne, or the one who narrates or describes (Vedas, Puranas, etc.)

in_tamil.name: ஹேமாநி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Goddess of wealth, bestower of prosperity, or the one who enriches with her words

in_telugu.name: హెమాని
in_telugu.long_meaning: Goddess of wealth, Goddess of prosperity, or the one who is the Goddess of speech and the one who presides over the throne

in_marathi.name: Hemani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hemani is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘hema’ which means wealth, prosperity, and fortune. It is believed that the name bestows its bearer with blessings of wealth and prosperity in all aspects of life.
